text: The Patriots head to Jacksonville for Week 3 facing a Jaguars squad looking to bounce back from their worst offensive performance in eleven months, though New England's own offensive identity remains a work in progress—yet the defense that dominated Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers in a 20-3 victory should provide some stability. On the injury front, the news is decidedly mixed: starting right guard Mike Onwenu has suffered a broken right ankle that will significantly impact the offensive line, while safety Dell Pettus has been placed on injured reserve, prompting the promotion of linebacker Jose Ramirez from the practice squad and the addition of linebacker Benton Whitley to the practice squad; the encouraging development is rookie tight end Eli Raridon's return to practice as his status is monitored for Sunday. Defensively, the Patriots will need to solve Jacksonville's Cover-6 looks and build on their successful "X" plays from earlier in the season, while offensively the team must address a troubling pattern of poor clock management in the final seconds before halftime that has plagued them through two consecutive games. The game kicks off at 1 PM ET on Sunday.
